question.prompt:
The shaded area is formed by two intersecting perpendicular rectangles, with dimensions as shown. Its area, in square units, is

[Figure 1](figures/1988_AMC_8_Q17_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
Split the shaded shape into the full vertical rectangle and the horizontal arm extending to its left. This makes two rectangles whose interiors do not overlap.

The vertical rectangle has width \(3\) and height \(8\), so its area is \(3\times 8=24\). The marked length \(10\) is the total width of the shape, including the vertical rectangle's width. Therefore the left arm has length \(10-3=7\) and height \(2\), giving area \(7\times 2=14\).

These two pieces cover the entire shaded shape exactly once, so its area is
\[
24+14=38
\]
square units, choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
solutions.title: Split into two rectangles
